name: last30days-chatgpt
description: ChatGPT-native research skill for understanding what changed and what people are saying about a topic over the last 30 days.

interface.shortDescription: Research what changed and what people are saying now.
interface.longDescription: A ChatGPT-native skill for recent-topic research across primary sources, the web, Reddit, YouTube, Hacker News, GitHub, and other accessible community sources, with recency checks, corroboration, and citations.
defaultPrompt: What changed in AI video generation in the last 30 days?
What are developers saying about the latest coding agents?
Compare the last 30 days of discussion around two products
